implementation_note.check_count_freeze: m = ceil(1.15 * H_q(p) / 10 * n) with H_q(p) = h2(p) + p*log2(q-1), n=1024. Exact arithmetic: p=.20 H_q = 2.7216461808364283 bits -> 1.15*H_q/10*1024 = 320.500895... -> m=321 (syndrome 3210 bits, rate 0.68652); p=.30 H_q = 3.880868028154292 bits -> 1.15*H_q/10*1024 = 457.011020... -> m=458 (syndrome 4580 bits, rate 0.55273). The task expectation '~457 for p=.30' is a rounding hint; exact arithmetic (ceil of 457.011020...) gives 458, which is the frozen count. frozen_check_count() and _CHECK_COUNTS = {0.20: 321, 0.30: 458} agree and are asserted in T0/T1.
implementation_note.de_recursion: faithful q-ary density evolution under the frozen two-level (symmetric) message projection: channel message ratios R_hi=(1-p)(q-1)/p w.p. 1-p and R_lo=p(q-1)/(q-1-p) w.p. p (exact projected QSC posterior); variable update R_v = R_ch * prod over d_v-1 check ratios (exact for two-level messages); check update is the exact GF(q) sum-distribution of d_c-1 independent two-level inputs via the closed convolution (P0',P1') = (P0*a+(q-1)*P1*b, P0*b+P1*a+(q-2)*P1*b) with a=R/(R+q-1), b=1/(R+q-1); belief R_bel = R_ch * prod of d_v check ratios, decision = transmitted symbol iff R_bel > 1. The recursion is a deterministic Monte-Carlo DE: every iteration draws exactly n_samples variable/check messages iid from the previous iteration's empirical density with a fixed-seed PCG64 generator, so it is byte-for-byte reproducible. At q=2 the two-level model is exact (standard binary BP DE); the q=1024 production path uses the same recursion whose cost is independent of q.
implementation_note.validation_vectors: INDEPENDENTLY tested against published/small-field vectors (spec.md R2 scientific identity): (a) q=2 BSC threshold of regular (3,6) reproduces the published ~0.084 (Richardson-Urbanke 2001) within tol 0.004; (b) the erasure-domain special case of the SAME recursion reproduces the published regular-ensemble BEC thresholds (3,6)=0.429438, (3,4)=0.647426, (4,8)=0.383441, (4,6)=0.506132 within tol 0.002 (published table e.g. arXiv cs/0410019 Table 1 and cs/0605130; an independent fixed-point tangency computation reproduces every value); (c) the two-level check-update convolution is verified EXACTLY against exhaustive GF(4) enumeration for every check degree 2..4; (d) the exact full-vector (unapproximated) FFT-QSPA check update equals exhaustive GF(4) enumeration; (e) at q=4 the full two-level DE threshold agrees with the exact full-vector Monte-Carlo DE threshold within tol 0.03 (the frozen deterministic approximation validated against the unapproximated recursion).
